title: Director IM Digital Technology Lead (Finance)
description:
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
   

  

 As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
   

  

**Job Function**
 Enterprise Management
   

  

**Job Sub Function**
 Technology Management
   

  

**Job Category**
 People Leader
   

  

**All Job Posting Locations:**
 PENJERLA, Telangana, India
   

  

**Job Description**
 Johnson \& Johnson is recruiting for an
 **IM Finance Digital Lead** 
 to support the Innovative Medicine (IM) Finance Transformation program. The preferred location for this role is in India
   

  

 At Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine, we are working to create a world without disease. Our focus is on transforming lives through earlier intervention, better treatments, and smarter approaches to prevention and cure. This is an opportunity to give to a passionate organization that brings together science, technology, and talent to improve health for patients around the world.
   

  

**Innovative Medicine Finance Transformation (IMFT)** 
 is a global finance transformation program that will modernize end\-to\-end finance processes across the Innovative Medicine value chain. The program is designed to standardize processes and data across financial planning activities, including FX, PII, and Tax, while enabling stronger actuals and variance analysis across the relevant capabilities. IMFT will also enable more consistent reporting across Finance teams. By building a scalable digital backbone, IMFT will strengthen business agility and address critical system modernization needs for the future.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines deep technical fluency in modern data platforms, analytics, and AI with strong financial competence and a proven track record of building and inspiring hard\-working teams in a captive/GCC environment.
   

  

 This is a senior, high\-impact leadership role responsible for shaping and scaling the Finance Data \& Analytics (D\&A) and AI capabilities for Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine Finance on a global scale. Anchored in the India Global Capability Center, the role sits at the intersection of Finance transformation, data and analytics strategy, modern technology platforms, and talent leadership. The Director will be accountable for building a best\-in\-class Finance D\&A capability that delivers trusted, governed, and AI\-enabled insights to Finance leaders worldwide.
   

  

 The role requires deep expertise in handling end\-to\-end Finance analytics products, owning technology strategy and platform decisions, and integrating Finance data solutions into the broader J\&J enterprise data and technology ecosystem. This leader will evaluate and adopt industry\-leading data, analytics, and AI technologies; translate Finance business priorities into scalable data products; and ensure solutions meet the highest standards of data quality, security, compliance, and auditability.
   

  

 A critical dimension of the role is people and capability leadership. The Director will build, lead, and develop a high\-performing captive team in India, establishing the Finance D\&A organization as a recognized global center of excellence. This includes defining the talent strategy, enabling exposure to global Finance partners and initiatives, and ensuring continuous development aligned with external industry trends and internal transformation priorities.
   

  

 Operating as a trusted partner to senior Finance, Technology, and Business leaders, the Director will co\-own the Finance D\&A agenda, balance critical initiatives with operational delivery, and drive measurable value through improved decision\-making, efficiency, and insight generation. Success in this role will be reflected in a modern, standardized, and sustainable Finance analytics landscape that accelerates Finance outcomes across Innovative Medicine.
   

  

**Major Duties \& Responsibilities**
 In order of importance, briefly describe, in sentence form, the essential functions/major responsibilities of this position (principal duties and responsibilities of the position) as it exists today. Describe the job, not the person in the job. Each item listed below should be a crucial function/major responsibility of the position, not a day\-to\-day activity.
   

  

 Typically, job descriptions should contain no more than seven or eight major responsibilities ranked in order of the highest percentage of time to least.
   

  

**Leadership**
* Serve as the overall leader for the IMFT product technology group, providing visible and effective leadership.
* Provide proactive assessment, alignment, and guidance to support team effectiveness and a positive, high\-performing environment.
* Maintain close engagement with team members and ensure they have the support, clarity, and resources needed to succeed in their roles and deliver objectives.
* Use continuous feedback and Johnson \& Johnson leadership principles to guide team members in both functional and non\-functional work.
* Serve as a main point of contact for multi\-functional leads and the program management team to proactively shape outcomes, anticipate risks, and mitigate issues.
* Drive clarity in talent development planning and represent the team in leadership forums related to talent and organizational development.
* Lead an international, cross\-regional team of Product Analysts through design, execution, and deployment.
* Coordinate, coach, motivate, and inspire the team to deliver against agreed plans while continuously improving performance.
* Help shape and grow the JJT organization to enable a global intake, build, and sustain models that support parallel program releases, ongoing operations, projects, and enhancements as IMFT Program is deployed.
* Develop a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
* Build and sustain a collaborative environment with vendor partners to support continuous enhancement for the IM Finance business.
* Lead product onboarding with internal J\&J technology team members.


**Technology Strategy \& Innovation**
* Continuously evaluate best\-in\-class, industry\-leading technology solutions to enhance data analytics and AI capabilities for the Finance function, including data platforms, visualization tools, machine learning frameworks, and generative AI applications.
* Conduct proof\-of\-concepts and structured vendor/tool assessments; build business cases and recommendations for technology investments aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
* Know the latest on external market trends, emerging technologies, and industry benchmarks; bring outside\-in perspective to shape the Finance D\&A technology roadmap.
* Partner with enterprise Technology, Data Engineering, and AI/ML teams to ensure Finance solutions leverage and influence the broader J\&J technology ecosystem.


**Solution Design, Build \& Delivery**
* Lead end\-to\-end design, development, and delivery of best\-in\-class Data \& Analytics solutions — from intake and requirements through, build, testing, deployment, and adoption.
* Establish and run Agile delivery practices (Scrum/Kanban, sprint planning, backlog management, iterative releases) to design, develop, and build parallel capabilities at speed and scale.
* Define and enforce engineering and analytics standards: reusable components, documentation, code quality, testing, and release management.
* Drive measurable business outcomes — improved forecasting accuracy, faster close cycles, self\-service insights, automation of manual reporting, and AI\-enabled decision support for Finance leaders.
* Ensure solutions remain aligned with all applicable regulatory and legal requirements (e.g., SOX, GxP where applicable, data privacy regulations such as GDPR/DPDP), and with J\&J internal controls, records management, and information security policies.
* Partner with Data Governance, Privacy, Legal, and Compliance teams to embed governance by design: data quality, master data alignment, access controls, auditability, and model governance for AI solutions.
* Rationalize and simplify the data landscape — reducing redundancy, technical debt, and shadow reporting in favor of governed, certified data products.


**Talent \& Capability Building (GCC Leadership)**
* Lead, manage, and grow the Finance Data \& Analytics team within the India Global Capability Center, establishing it as a recognized center of excellence.
* Define and implement the talent strategy: workforce planning, hiring, role architecture, career pathing, succession planning, and retention of top data, analytics, and AI talent.
* Provide team members with significant exposure to global capabilities — global projects, cross\-regional rotations, direct engagement with worldwide Finance and business leaders.
* Ensure structured exposure to external Data, Analytics, and AI capabilities — industry forums, certifications, partnerships with technology providers and academia, and external benchmarking.
* Develop a culture of innovation, continuous learning, psychological safety, and accountability consistent with the J\&J Credo.


**Business Partnership \& Collaborator Leadership**
* Shape and co\-lead the Data \& Analytics agenda with Finance and business leadership across multiple, concurrent priorities — balancing critical initiatives with operational demands.
* Build trusted relationships with internal collaborators (Finance leadership, FP\&A, Controllership, Supply Chain Finance, Commercial Finance, Technology) and external collaborators (technology vendors, consulting partners, industry peers).
* Translate business problems into data and AI solution roadmaps; communicate complex technical concepts clearly to senior non\-technical audiences.
* Define and report on value realization — benchmarks, goals and achievements, and benefits supervising for the D\&A portfolio.


**Other Duties**
* Represent the Finance technology team in program\-related forums, including Deployment, Change Management, Compliance, Methodology, and Testing.
* Create opportunities to provide significant exposure and development for team members.


**Required Qualifications**
**Required Minimum Education** 
 : Degree in Finance
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Finance, Analytics, or a related field; MBA or Master's in a quantitative rigor preferred.
   

  

**Required Years Of Related Experience**
 18\+ years of dynamic experience in data, analytics, and technology, including 5\+ years in a leadership role; experience supporting a Finance function strongly preferred.
   

  

**Required Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* Demonstrated experience building and leading teams in a captive/GCC or global shared\-service's environment, including talent strategy and capability development.
* Hands\-on familiarity with modern data and analytics ecosystems — e.g., SAP Datasphere, cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), data engineering and lineage tools (Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica, Collibra or similar), BI/visualization (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik), and AI/ML and GenAI technologies.
* Proven delivery leadership using Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent) across parallel workstreams.
* Solid understanding of data governance, data lineage, internal controls, and regulatory/compliance requirements relevant to Finance (e.g., SOX) and to the pharmaceutical industry.
* Exceptional collaborator management, communication, and influencing skills with global, matrixed senior audiences.


**Preferred**
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, or other highly regulated industries.
* Experience with finance systems and data (SAP S/4HANA, ERP financial data models, planning tools such as Anaplan/TM1\).
* Track record of deploying AI/GenAI use cases into production with appropriate model governance.
* Certifications in cloud, data, Agile, or program management (e.g., AWS/Azure certifications, SAFe, PMP, CSM).


**Leadership Skills \& Behaviors**
* Demonstrates a focus on business agility, Agile delivery, a fail\-fast attitude, and measurable outcomes.
* Demonstrated success in leading cross\-functional self\-organized teams.
* Experience working in a global environment and leading teams across multiple countries.
* Experience effectively collaborating and managing partners.
* Gives ideas that challenge conventional thinking and advance outcomes.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to accurately assess situations and make sound decisions based on informed judgment.
* Demonstrates a continuous learning attitude and seeks new ways to implement features and capabilities that improve customer satisfaction.


**Travel On The Job**
 Limited travel 10
 **%**
**People Management Experience**
**Required Years of People Management Experience** 
 : A minimum of 5 years
   

  

**Preferred Related Proven Experience** 
 (if applicable):
 **Pharmaceuticals** 
 or Healthcare
   

  

**Preferred Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Applied knowledge on Finance Transformation.
* People management experience, including developing, mentoring, and coaching others.
* Experience working in a global/regional setting.
* Experience in a large\-scale business transformation program.
* Experience handling a product backlog and release plan, supervising team\-level metrics, attending product team ceremonies, and removing blockers.


**Key Working Relationships**
**Internal**
 Pharm Transcend business and technology teams.
   

  

 JJT teams supporting applications in the ERP ecosystem.
   

  

**External**
 Vendors supporting the Pharm Transcend program.
   

  

 This role covers full people leadership, including hiring decisions, team development, work planning, and quality oversight. It also includes performance management (reviews, pay and promotions), employee relations (grievances and terminations), and budget recommendations and decisions.
   

  

**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
 Business Case Modeling, Business Requirements Analysis, Corporate Management, Cross\-Functional Collaboration, Developing Others, Emerging Technologies, Gap Analysis, Global Market, Inclusive Leadership, Leadership, Operational Excellence, Performance Measurement, Product Improvements, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Management, Product Strategies, Quality Assurance (QA), Risk Management, Technical Credibility

title: Finance Master Data Owner
description:
**Finance Master Data Owner – Job Description**
 The Finance Master Data Owner manages and governs Finance master data across enterprise\-wide Sandoz processes, ensuring data integrity, quality, governance, and compliance with internal standards and external regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Major Accountabilities**
* Own the Finance master data governance framework and global standards aligned with Sandoz policies.
* Oversee and continuously improve Finance master data processes to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance across ERP/ Finance/ analytics platforms.
* Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to define, enforce, and evolve data standards and stewardship roles.
* Monitor and report data quality (completeness, validity, consistency); drive corrective actions and preventive improvements.
* Lead data cleansing and enrichment initiatives; measure impact on data reliability and downstream processes.
* Provide training and guidance to users and data stewards on governance processes, tools, and best practices.
* Serve as the bridge between IT and business during transformations, migrations, and integrations to safeguard data design and controls.
* Conduct regular audits/assessments to ensure adherence to governance policies and regulatory requirements (e.g., privacy).
* Drive continuous improvement and automation to enhance master data lifecycle efficiency and control effectiveness.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* Data Accuracy \& Integrity: High accuracy and consistency of Finance master data across systems.
* Governance Compliance: Adherence to Sandoz standards and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Process Efficiency: Timely execution of creation, updates, and lifecycle changes.
* Data Quality Monitoring: Regular tracking and sustained improvement of quality metrics.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Effective engagement and responsiveness to cross‑functional teams.
* Project Delivery: Successful completion of migration/integration activities within agreed timelines.
* Continuous Improvement: Demonstrable enhancements in processes and governance maturity.
* Risk Management: Proactive identification and mitigation of Finance master data risks.


**Minimum Requirements**
 Work Experience:
   

  

* 10\+ years overall SAP experience, with 5\+ years in SAP MDG architecture and SAP MDG for Finance (MDG\-F).
* Experience with S/4HANA (on\-prem or cloud), BRF\+, workflows, and Fiori UI


* Proven experience with BADIs, data migration, data governance and Integration with SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Advanced analytical and problem‑solving skills focused on data accuracy and process optimization.
* Proficient in SQL, Excel, and data analysis methodologies.
* Solid understanding of data governance principles, controls, and best practices.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across organizational levels.
+ Good to have:
- SAP S4HANA, SAP MDG experience.
- Professional certifications in SAP MDG / Data Governance.


**Skills**
* Effective collaboration within global, virtual teams.
* High initiative, ownership of results, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Team‑oriented mindset with strong presentation and stakeholder engagement skills.


**Languages**
* English.

title: Officer 3, Data Governance
description:
**Company Description**
**ABOUT IQ\-EQ**
 We’re a leading Investor Services group offering end\-to\-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide.  We employ a global workforce of 6,500\+ people across 24 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$857 billion. We work with 13 of the world’s top\-15 private equity firms.
   

  

 Our services are underpinned by a Group\-wide commitment to ESG and best\-in\-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in\-house experts.
   

  

 Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding.
   

  

 We’re driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Introduction**
 The Data Governance Analyst will support the implementation, optimisation, and ongoing management of the Treasury Management Solution (TMS) by ensuring the quality, integrity, consistency, and governance of treasury data across the organisation. This role partners with business and technology stakeholders to establish data governance frameworks, improve data quality, support treasury operations, and ensure reliable data is available for decision\-making, reporting, and regulatory requirements.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* You'll support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of treasury data governance policies, standards, controls, and accountability frameworks.
* You'll establish and maintain data quality frameworks, metrics, and monitoring processes, while identifying, analysing, and resolving data quality issues related to completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness.
* You'll define and maintain treasury data ownership, stewardship, and accountability models, ensuring effective governance across treasury data domains.
* You'll document data lineage and support end\-to\-end mapping of treasury data flows to improve transparency, traceability, and data management practices.
* You'll respond to data\-related queries, participate in testing, data migration and reconciliation activities, and support ad hoc treasury and project initiatives as required.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive Total Rewards Package: Comprehensive annual compensation including basic salary, HRA, special allowance, provident fund, gratuity, internet allowance, and food allowance.
* Health \& Insurance Coverage: Medical insurance, group term life insurance, and personal accident insurance.
* Allowances \& Support: Transportation/transport allowance and shift allowance.
* Paid Time Off: Generous leave policy to support work–life balance.


**Qualifications**
**About you**
* You have experience in Data Governance, Data Management, Business Analysis, Treasury Systems, or a related discipline.
* You have a strong understanding of treasury operations, treasury data domains, and Treasury Management Systems such as Kyriba, FIS Quantum, GTreasury, SAP Treasury, Reval, Integrity, or similar platforms.
* You have knowledge of data quality management, data lineage, metadata management, master data governance, and experience supporting data migration, reconciliation, and testing activities.
* You possess strong analytical, problem\-solving, and advanced Excel/data analysis skills, with the ability to interpret and manage complex datasets.
* You communicate effectively with cross\-functional business and technology stakeholders and demonstrate excellent documentation, written, and verbal communication skills.


**Additional Information**
**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT**
 Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long\-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.
   

  

 There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.
   

  

 Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500\+ employees \- from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries \- to each achieve their potential. Through IQ\-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.
   

  

 We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

 L’Hôpital d’Elavagnon agit dans la région de l’Est\-Mono au Togo depuis 1981, auprès des populations locales. Spécialisé dans l’accompagnement de la mère et de l’enfant, l’hôpital comprend 93 lits répartis au sein des services de pédiatrie, maternité, médecine et chirurgie.
   

  

 En lien avec le personnel de l’hôpital et les autorités locales, le
 **Volontaire de solidarité Internationale (VSI),** 
 véritable bras droit du directeur de l’hopital, sera en charge de coordonner les différents services administratifs, afin de veiller à la bonne gestion hospitalière.
   

  

**Ce Projet, Comprend Plusieurs Activités, Tels Que**
* Organisation et coordination de l’administration de l’hôpital
* Gestion financière, gestion de trésorerie, gestion budgétaire et contrôle de gestion
* Gestion des stocks et des immobilisations
* Relations extérieures
* Organisation d’évènements au sein de l’hôpital


 Au sein de ce projet, le VSI sera chargé des missions suivantes :
   

  

 1/
 **Organisation et coordination de l’administration de l’hôpital**
* Définir les procédures et les protocoles administratifs, de l’étude des besoins au suivi financier
* Contrôler le respect des procédures pour chaque service de l’hôpital et proposer des améliorations pour renforcer le bon fonctionnement de l’hôpital,


 2/
 **Gestion financière, gestion de trésorerie, gestion budgétaire et contrôle de gestion**
* Analyser les recettes et dépenses de l’hôpital et proposer des améliorations pour renforcer l’autonomie financière de l’hôpital,
* Superviser la gestion comptable et fiscale avec le comptable ; la gestion de la paie avec le service RH ; la prise en charge des indigents avec l’assistant social ;
* Conseiller et assister le directeur de l’hôpital en matière de gestion financière (engagement des dépenses, suivi de la trésorerie, faisabilité de nouveaux projets…),
* Participer à la rédaction des rapports d’activités et de leurs annexes financières,
* Préparer, en lien avec la direction, les budgets en conformité avec les orientations de la direction de l’Ordre de Malte France. Contrôler leur réalisation par activité, service (ex : pharmacie, fonctionnement de l’hôpital, etc.),
* Proposer et concevoir des outils d’analyse financière et budgétaire,
* Participer aux comités de direction et aux réunions des responsables de services pour apporter un éclairage budgétaire (conseil, contrôle et suivi).


 3/
 **Gestion des stocks et des immobilisations**
* Rationaliser la gestion des stocks de médicaments et superviser les commandes mensuelles pour satisfaire les besoins de l’hôpital tout en prenant en compte ses contraintes budgétaires,
* Contrôler la bonne utilisation et la bonne mise à jour des logiciels de gestion et les utiliser pour réaliser des analyses permettant d’améliorer le fonctionnement de l’hôpital,
* Gérer les immobilisations de l’hôpital.


 4/
 **Relations extérieures**
* Développer et entretenir les relations avec les fournisseurs de médicaments de l’hôpital,
* Superviser les relations avec les organismes de contrôle (Office Togolais des Recettes, EXCO).

title: Senior Manager Finance - M&A and Divestments
description:
**Job Purpose**
 In this role you will be responsible for evaluating, structuring, and executing the financial component of complex transactions that support the company’s strategic objectives, including acquisitions, divestitures, and strategic partnerships. You will be a key business partner for the M\&A team and provide an essential bridge between the world of transaction\-related finance and internal corporate finance and other functional teams.
   

  

 The role requires a strong blend of strategic thinking, transaction experience, financial acumen, and cross\-functional collaboration to support the company’s long\-term growth agenda. This will include financial evaluations and risk assessments on M\&A and divestments, negotiation support and presentation to the corresponding governance bodies, building in\-depth knowledge of the business and work closely with all needed stakeholders (eg tax, treasury, funds flow, and supply hubs) and conduct post\-evaluation of M\&A and divestment deals.
   

  

 The incumbent will be a key business partner for the M\&A team, connecting them through a lens of financial transactions to the broader Sandoz internal finance and other teams and bridging that gap.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Create financial modelling, valuation, and scenario analysis for M\&A and other strategic initiatives.
* Assist in due diligence processes and preparation of financial materials for internal and external stakeholders.
* Execute the financial aspects of integration and separation planning by supporting financial workstreams and tracking synergy realization or cost impacts.
* Collaborate with Strategy, Corporate Development, and Business Unit teams to evaluate investment opportunities and strategic options.
* Prepare business cases and financial presentations for senior leadership review.
* Conduct market and competitor financial analysis to support strategic recommendations.
* Ensure compliance with financial governance and internal controls throughout project execution.
* Supports post\-deal analysis and post\-implementation reviews to assess actual vs. planned outcomes of transformation and capture lessons learned. Required BPA activities around the finances of the Transformation and Growth function.
* Ad\-hoc requests and support.


**Key Performance indicators**
* Successful completion of projects
* Realization of synergies and value creation targets such as NPV, ROIC, payback
* Transformation Initiative delivery
* Accuracy and timeliness of forecasts
* On time and on budget integration and separation after transaction completion
* Compliance of financial processes with Sandoz Financial Control Framework requirements
* Meeting internal reporting deadlines


**Minimum Requirements**
* Chartered Accountant, MBA Finance / CFA
* 8–10 years of experience in Corporate Finance, investment banking, consulting, Corporate M\&A, due diligence or a similar analytical role.
* Strong financial modelling and analytical skills with attention to detail.
* Experience supporting M\&A, transformation or strategic finance projects is preferred.
* Excellent communication and presentation (Written and Verbal) skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across functions and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, financial analysis tools, and project tracking tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, or similar).
* Experience in life sciences, healthcare, or a similarly dynamic and regulated industry is a plus.


**Why consider Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2025 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us!
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

title: Spec-Business Intelligence
description:
When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing...**
 At Verizon, we aren't just building a world\-class Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) organization—we are fundamentally redefining the future of finance. As we step into the AI era, we are pioneering intelligent, AI\-driven FP\&A practices that will completely transform how finance teams operate and deliver strategic value. Through a comprehensive initiative to streamline processes, modernize our systems, and invest heavily in the continuous growth of our people, we are setting the industry standard. This is your opportunity to be the catalyst for this AI\-powered revolution, helping us make Verizon the ultimate destination for forward\-thinking FP\&A professionals.
   

  

 Move Beyond Compiling Data And Help Tell The Story Behind The Numbers. The Corporate FP\&A Positions Offer Opportunities To Drive Better Business Partnering And Insights While Developing Your Skill Set And Leadership As We Continue To Grow As a World\-class Organization. You Are a Valuable Business Partner, Finding New And Better Ways Of Working By Leveraging Digital And AI Capabilities. You’ll Become Involved In Planning, Reporting, Analyses, And Initiatives That Will Impact Important Decisions Around The Growth And Development Of Verizon's Business. In Our Department, You Will
   

  

* Architect Intelligent Workflows: Identify bottlenecks in traditional FP\&A processes (like month\-end close or manual data consolidation) and spearhead the implementation of automations and AI solutions.
* AI\-Enhanced Data Storytelling: Transform complex, multi\-layered datasets into clear, actionable intelligence using advanced data visualization tools and AI\-generated insights.
* Bridge Finance and Technology: Act as the crucial link between traditional FP\&A and data science teams, ensuring AI algorithms are trained with deep financial context and commercial acumen
* Prompt Engineering for Finance: Utilize generative AI tools to rapidly synthesize financial data, draft preliminary variance narratives, and accelerate the reporting cycle.
* Ensure timely and accurate delivery of financial planning, reporting \& analyses for the business.
* Be a trusted advisor by providing valuable decision support and guidance to FP\&A Business Partners.
* Proactive Value Creation: Move beyond retrospective reporting to become a forward\-looking strategic advisor, using AI\-driven scenario planning to guide executive decision\-making and identify growth opportunities.
* Actively participate in the cultural and professional development of Corporate FP\&A as a world\-class organization through Mentor/Mentee relationships and various activities offered.
* Be the Impetus for Change: Champion the adoption of AI and modern finance practices across the broader Verizon team, overcoming resistance to change through education and proven results.


 As part of the Corporate FP\&A team, you will be helping the reporting and accounting teams deliver world\-class, zero\-touch automated solutions for all Verizon entities. You will interact with finance teams across the business, bringing new automated and AI\-driven solutions to life for our month\-end financial close and reporting activities.
   

  

**Reporting, Automation \& Data Visualization**
* Deliver best\-in\-class end\-to\-end automated solutions for our stakeholders to support Finance Business Units (BUs) and drive efficiencies.
* Design data visualizations of financial statements for different organizations across Verizon.
* Deliver C\-Suite Executive reporting with 100% quality and accuracy.
* Collaborate with the various stakeholders to deploy Qlik/ Looker Applications in production environments and resolve any production issues with existing applications.
* Document processes to ensure accuracy across the enterprise and maintain strict change control.


**AI \& Analytics Systems Architecture**
* Design and build AI solutions that interact with development tools, codebases, and team workflows in meaningful ways.
* Work extensively with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, Codex, and others) to understand their capabilities, limitations, and optimal application patterns for financial automation.
* Own the developer experience of agentic interactions—making complex AI capabilities feel natural and trustworthy for finance end\-users.
* Lead technical decision\-making on agent patterns, model selection, and integration approaches.


 What we’re looking for…
   

  

 You are a strong collaborator who can effectively own and prioritize multiple work streams and adapt during pressured situations. You display initiative and resourcefulness but are also comfortable brainstorming and sharing ideas in a team environment. You possess excellent communication skills and can partner effectively across multiple business and finance teams to speak to both internal and external stakeholders. You are adaptable to change, meet tight deadlines, and are strongly focused on the quality of your deliverables.
   

  

**You'll Need To Have**
* Bachelor’s degree and Four or more years of work experience in financial report automations.
* Five or more years of relevant work experience in Business Intelligence/Analytics within FP\&A teams (but not limited to this function).
* Hands on experience in Qlik Sense \& Tableau.
* Experience with Looker, LookML will be an added advantage
* Vizlib and NPrinting experience in Qlik Sense.
* Deep, hands\-on experience building AI agents or agentic systems in production.
* Strong understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations across multiple models (Claude, Gemini, Codex, etc.).
* Expertise in prompt engineering, model selection, and working with tool\-use/function calling.
* Ability to mine, extract, transform, and load large financial datasets to create zero\-touch reports.
* Working knowledge of report automation tools, technologies, and end\-to\-end ETL processes (e.g., Knime Analytics Platform, Alteryx).
* Experience with Qlik Sense and QVD generations from different data sources.
* Experience in Essbase, SQL, and SQL performance tuning.
* Knowledge of Google Suite, database management systems, and ticketing tools (e.g., Jira).


 Even better if you have one or more of the following:
   

  

* Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for agentic systems and understanding of the practical tradeoffs in production.
* Basic knowledge of programming languages essential for modern data and AI work (e.g., Python, Google App Scripting, React.js, etc.,).
* Background in developer tools, productivity platforms, or engineering analytics.
* Exposure to GCP Big Query and Teradata databases.
* A proven ability to derive insights from data and recommend actionable business strategies.
